notes.title: Reskue build 1141
notes.content:
===================
Reskue build 1141
===================
* No flashing menus
+ New animation shoot and use item for hero (both Reskue and Colony)
+ Scientists stops move from hero when using items
+ Added enemy droids used 3 types weapon with negative effects. Some can be healed by firstaid.
+ New controller menu
+ Menu text can be scrolled using pad
+ Death take 25% xp.
+ Added new armor (slot1). Can work only without tank
When you get damage starts fast regeneration drains protection level.
+ Fixed word printing long texts.
+ Load menu shows only when saves exists.
+ Save game shows only when Player have score
+ Protect shield lower 2 times any negative effects.
+ Code:: command_power parameter now works.
+ Fix:: Old shoot mod.
+ Authors:: Now shows arts and models in menu
+ Added option settings: Disable touchscreen for android PS3/Xbox controller using.

notes.title: Update 757
notes.content:
Reskue build 658...757  Bugfixes, safezone
===========================================
EN
+ Game is over if killed more than 70% scientists.
Counter disappear if no lived humans on base.
+ Full animated tanks
+ Sprife frozen object fixed.
+ Stun rifle lower protect of enemies. New graphical effect
+ Saved game now correct load list of saved scientists and fuel.
+ Visuals enemy miniguns fixed.
+ Automoving map not wait player to cross border of screen.
+ Help updated
+ Solar energy maximum 900.
+ GUI changed, weapon can be found on down of screen. 
+ Numblock keyboars "." key now can swap tank if selected tank offscreen. 
+ Editor: item info added about rikochet and nodrop.
For translation other languages added info about ID item for fast found in smsg.ini
+ Added Safe zone without any enemies, after zone with acid. 
+ Increased damage grenade launcher.
+ Rescue map: Added electricity lock to entering ship. Added Paralyzator ammo.
+ Fix: Hero not broke CC with doing order (from joystick) 
+ Fix: Scientists can repair final teleport.
+ Fix: Green tanks with aura or repair reduce power of repairing
+ Fix: Radioactive fuel and minigun not disappear if you take it with full inventory
+ Added + marker for HP

notes.title: Update 657 summary
notes.content:
=================== 
Reskue build 606
===================
EN
+ NEW! Hotseat (Coop mode, versus mode), Multiplayer. Maximum 3 players at one PC. Info,howto and tactics at help center ingame (f2)
+ New animations of scientist and hero.
+ Special effect for every type ammo shard.
+ Fix: No wasting ammo using unexisted weapon mode.
+ Fix: Removed unused items from SC (shipping center) and editor.
+ Fix: Autoimporter Reskue + from ZX/Hobeta better use old maps from Zx-Spectrum. Autoremove broken teleport 
+ Fix: Left stick on controller is enabled by default
+ Fix: Left fire fire on controller allows use inventory instead of fire. Select by clicking on right stick.
+ Fix: Animation on stick using on controler
+ Fix: Tank hero not increase power of shooting enemies.
+ Reworked menu pause(actions) F1
+ Fixed loading image
+ Music off flag now works when game loads.
+ Bombs with using Freeze gun not exploding as normal. Freezes all nearest enemies.
+ Fixed: AOE effect by player copied to tanks
+ Fixed: Freeze trap
+ Minigun and grenadelauncher now lower moving speed.
+ Fixed: Aura tanks now works correct. (Repair, pain reflection, protect)
+ Fixed: Corrosion works on enemies.
+ Fixed: Traps do mass effect more correct
+ Fixed: Pain reflection
+ Reduce cooldown on some type enemies.
+ Code: mass_effect stop working on editor or all enemies dead
+ Code: enhanced ammo class clean. No dissapears ammo.
+ Added note about Fear when using on white tanks

=================== 
Reskue build 635
===================
EN
+ Added help center (F2, and pause menu)
+ Fix: Minigun 
+ Retexture cryocaplules
+ Redefine keys now allow change healing and resurrect keys, remove armor.

=================== 
Reskue build 646
===================
EN
+ Added Effect when tanks dead
+ Protect belt now protects from anomaly with using one medkit. Works only without tank.
+ Added exit benchmark from controller/joystick 

=================== 
Reskue build 657
===================
EN
+ Added base GUI elements ingame window, hide sysinfo and time.
+ Help window in left write 
+ Fixed invisiblity
